neighbours.label: a maths or genetics setup where things come in a pair: quadratic roots, the discriminant, two gene copies
fire: Every quadratic equation has two roots, possibly equal.
Since the discriminant is zero, the two solutions coincide.
Each individual inherits two alleles, one from each parent.
A recessive disease appears when both copies of the gene are defective.
Because the discriminant is positive, the parabola crosses the axis twice.
Diploid cells carry two copies of every chromosome.
A square root of an even order has two solutions in the reals.
Homozygous plants carry two identical alleles of that gene.
quiet: Every straight line has one slope, possibly zero.
Since the total is zero, the account is closed.
Each employee receives two badges, one for each building.
A rare disease appears when the liver is damaged by toxins.
Because the weather is warm, the river runs past the town.
Muscle cells burn plenty of sugar during exercise.
A cube of even size has six faces in the box.
Healthy plants need plenty of water during summer.

notes: Card: ' two' x4, ' solutions', ' copies'. Probes: 'discriminant is positive' 1.0, 'two roots' 0.4, 'two copies of each gene' 0.57, against 'two brothers' 0.05, 'test came back positive' 0.09. Mixed regime (57% +g -u).
